regime.instructions: Image 1 is the BTCUSDT chart (candles, EMA20 blue, EMA50 orange, volume) beside the order book depth within 1% of mid. The state holds the same candle and book metrics as numbers. Classify the regime for the NEXT 12 candles (3 hours on 15m). TRENDING means price is expected to travel at least 2x ATR in one direction over that window with little back-and-forth; ADX alone is not enough. Watch for a squeeze: a tightly coiled market often releases into a large one-way move. Prefer CHOPPY only for an ordinary range, not for a coil.

criteria.TRENDING: Expected to carry at least 2x ATR in one direction in the next 12 candles. Either (a) an energetic move already under way: ADX above 25 AND EMA20/EMA50 separation above ~0.4% and widening, Bollinger width expanding (roughly above 1%), volume at or above average, book not leaning against it; or (b) a squeeze about to release: Bollinger width very narrow (under ~0.9%) while ADX is very high (above ~40) and volume is picking up from its lows (vol_ratio_vs_50 rising toward 0.7 or more).
criteria.CHOPPY: An ordinary range or low-energy drift unlikely to travel 2x ATR in the next 12 candles: EMAs flat, interleaved or separated by less than ~0.3%, ADX moderate (roughly 20-35), volume well below average (vol_ratio_vs_50 under ~0.5), bands not unusually tight, or the book leaning against the recent direction. A tight coil with very high ADX and rising volume is NOT choppy; it is a squeeze (see TRENDING).
criteria.PANIC: Disorderly stress: price likely to swing 4x ATR or more, or print a single candle of 3x ATR or more, WITHOUT a clean one-way path (whipsaw, a sudden drop and snap-back, a liquidation cascade). Signs: ATR jumping far above its recent average, a volume spike, a fast drawdown, spread widening or one side of the book thinning out. A large but orderly one-way rally or selloff is TRENDING, not PANIC.

take.instructions: The state describes a proposed trade (playbook, side, entry, stop, target) plus the current regime, candle metrics and order book. Image 1 is the chart and depth snapshot. Will price reach the target before the stop?

criteria.true: TAKE: the setup is clean for this playbook, the regime supports it, the book does not lean against it, and reward to risk is realistic.
criteria.false: SKIP: the setup is weak, late, against the order flow, into a nearby wall, or the regime does not fit the playbook.

book_control.instructions: From the order book metrics (imbalances, walls, spread) and the last candle's taker-buy share, who is in control of short-term price right now?

criteria.BUYERS: Bids clearly heavier near mid, aggressive taker buying, asks being lifted.
criteria.SELLERS: Asks clearly heavier near mid, aggressive taker selling, bids being hit.

entry.instructions: Given who controls the book and the urgency of this setup, how should the order be entered?

criteria.MARKET: Momentum favors the trade and the book is with it; waiting likely means a worse price or a missed move. Spread is tight.
criteria.LIMIT: No urgency or a pullback toward the entry is likely; resting at the best bid (long) or best ask (short) should fill at a better price.
criteria.WAIT: Order flow currently leans against the trade or the book is unstable; re-check on the next candle.
